notes.title: Demo Update Coming up next Weekend!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

We want to start by sending a huge thank you to each and every one of you who took the time to try out the demo and share your valuable feedback with us. Your insights have been absolutely amazing!

Over the past couple of weeks, we’ve been hard at work, fixing bugs and making improvements based on what you’ve shared. We’re excited to announce that an update will be coming to the demo by the end of this weekend! We can’t wait for you to experience the changes, and we truly appreciate your patience as we continue to fine-tune things.

Building Indoras is a journey we’re taking together with all of you, and your support means the world to us. We’re committed to making this game something special, and your feedback plays a huge role in shaping it. As always, we encourage you to join us on our Discord Server—let's keep the conversation and build the community.

Also, we’ve started running weekly raffles for our community members! Don’t miss out on the fun—join us on Discord to participate and see what’s up for grabs!


[url=https://discord.gg/eSepR9zPaW][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493026/75ec86791a878427bdcd5de614bc3d336afb614c.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Thank you again for being part of this incredible journey. Together, we’re making Indoras come to life![/h3]
